race.comment: NAILS AND PRIDE (1) sets the standard after a sound third in Benchmark 66 grade at Grafton, beaten a length and a half under 62.5kg and now meeting this with a lighter impost and a strong jockey-horse record in his corner. XTRA APPROVAL (5) was plain at Tuncurry over 1500m, but his previous Taree fourth, beaten half a length at long odds, is a very competitive reference and the back in trip angle gives him a clear rebound case. HE'S GODSPEED (6) brings consistent heavy-track Taree form around 1614m, including a last-start fifth beaten two lengths, and the drop to 55kg is a genuine asset if he returns sharp enough. GET SOME FUN (4) will be fitter for recent racing and is better placed.
